hero.description: I build web and mobile apps: clean architecture, fast interfaces and measurable results. Scroll down.
hero.location: baku, azerbaijan — open to new projects

manifesto.label: (01) — about
manifesto.text: I'm Isa — a *frontend developer* with 2+ years of experience. I build *responsive, user-centric* web and mobile apps with React, React Native and TypeScript. At Opportuland I rebuilt the onboarding flow and *grew daily registrations by 111%;* at NextClass I built a restaurant management system *from scratch.*

stats.label: (02) — in numbers
stats.lead: Writing code is one thing; delivering results is another. These are the measurable ones.

items.registrations: daily registrations after the new onboarding flow

principle.label: (03) — how I work
principle.text: Clean code, clear architecture and *measurable results.* Every component is *reusable,* every request is cached, every interface works *on every screen.*
principle.coda: api → hooks → UI: components never call the network directly.

frontend.title: Web apps
frontend.description: Fast, accessible and scalable web apps with React and TypeScript: a considered folder structure, data flow with TanStack Query, interfaces in three languages.

mobile.title: Mobile apps
mobile.description: Apps for Android, iOS and the web from one codebase with React Native and Expo. Accounts, sync and notifications with Supabase.

motion.title: Motion & interaction
motion.description: Scroll animations, micro-interactions and PWAs. Animations run on the GPU, stay smooth on weak phones and respect reduced motion.

ai.title: AI-assisted development
ai.description: I use AI as part of the work: to set up the architecture, review the code and ship faster without losing quality.

nextclass.description: Built a restaurant management system (NextCook) on my own: architecture, database and front end. On an exam website, improved data fetching and navigation with TanStack Query and routing.

codelandia.description: High-performance web apps with React, SCSS and modern JavaScript; turned complex UI/UX designs into pixel-perfect interfaces and built reusable components.

opportuland.description: Redesigned the step-based onboarding flow — daily registrations rose by 111%. A mobile app with React Native and Expo and the company website; started as an intern in a remote Agile team.

edu.description: Engineering and computer graphics, linear algebra and analytic geometry, ergonomics and technical design, mathematical analysis.
